title: CONSTRUCTION OF IRREDUCIBLE REPRESENTATIONS OVER KHOVANOV-LAUDA-ROUQUIER ALGEBRAS
abstract: We give an explicit construction of irreducible modules over Khovanov-Lauda- Rouquier algebras R and their cyclotomic quotients Rλ for ﬁnite classical types using a crystal basis theoretic approach. More precisely, for each element v of the crystal B(∞) (resp. B(λ)), we ﬁrst construct certain modules ∆(a; k) labeled by the adapted string a of v. We then prove that the head of the induced module Ind �∆(a; 1)⊠· · ·⊠∆(a; n)  is irreducible and that every irreducible R-module (resp. Rλ-module) can be realized as the irreducible head of one of the induced modules Ind(∆(a; 1) ⊠· · · ⊠∆(a; n)). Moreover, we show that our construction is compatible with the crystal structure on B(∞) (resp. B(λ)).
